localTopics.description: Handles customer requests to cancel, amend, update, or rebook an existing car rental reservation, including email, flight, pickup/drop-off date, time, and location.

localActions.description: Updates an existing verified rental booking through the booking API for changed fields only: driver email, flight number, pickup location, drop-off location, pickup datetime, or drop-off datetime. Use when the customer wants to keep the same booking but change details. Collect only fields they want to change, repeat the new values, and call this only after the customer confirms those values. Requires Verified Contact Id and Booking Number. Leave unchanged fields blank. Do not use this action to cancel, create a new booking, verify identity, or fetch alternatives. Do not claim the change was saved unless success is true.

Cancels a verified rental booking in the booking system. Use only after Get Booking Details and Get Booking Alternatives have been used in this conversation, the customer has heard the cancellation fee and alternatives, and they explicitly confirm they still want to cancel. Set Customer Confirmed Cancellation to true only after that confirmation. Requires Verified Contact Id and Booking Number. Do not call this on the customer's first cancel request. Do not use this action to amend, rebook, verify identity, or look up a booking. If success is false, say the booking is still active and do not tell the customer it was cancelled.

Returns amendment and rebooking options for a verified booking. Always call this when the customer asks to cancel, before Cancel Booking, and present options in plain language: (1) amend dates, locations, email, or flight, (2) rebook a different vehicle or time, (3) cancel only if they still want to cancel. Requires Verified Contact Id and Booking Number. Use also when the customer is unsure whether to change or cancel. Do not use this action to verify identity, save an amendment, create a new booking, or cancel. Never treat this action as a completed cancellation.

Loads one verified customer's rental booking and refreshes it from the booking API so chat uses current pickup, drop-off, vehicle, email, flight, status, and cancellation fee. Use when the customer asks about an existing reservation, or before amend, rebook, or cancel so you have accurate details. Requires Verified Contact Id and Booking Number from Verify Customer Identity. Summarize the booking in customer-friendly language. Do not use this action to verify identity, list alternatives, change the booking, create a new booking, or cancel. If success is false, do not invent booking details.

Creates a new rental booking from the customer's pickup location, drop-off location, pickup datetime, drop-off datetime, and vehicle class, and marks the original booking as rebooked. Use when the customer wants a different trip instead of cancelling or instead of a small amendment. Collect every required field before calling. Do not guess missing dates, times, locations, or vehicle class. Requires Verified Contact Id and Original Booking Number. Repeat the new trip details and call only after the customer confirms. Read back the new booking number from the action output. Do not use this action to verify identity, amend a few fields on the same booking, or cancel without creating a new reservation.

Verifies the customer before any private booking action by matching booking number and the email on the reservation. Use this as the first action in a Booking Changes conversation, or whenever Verified Contact Id is missing. On success, store Verified Contact Id and Booking Number in agent variables and confirm the trip in plain language. Do not use this action to look up full booking details, offer alternatives, amend, rebook, or cancel. Do not invent a booking number or email. If verification fails, ask the customer to recheck booking number and email. Do not expose Salesforce IDs to the customer.
